Interested candidates should submit a cover letter describing why they're interested in working as an intern in a congressional office. Experience that applies to being an intern in the district office should also be included. Our office also requires a resume that highlights relevant experience related to the position. The application deadline is Friday, August 9th, 2024, at 11:59 PM CT. Interested applicants should fill out an application at https://hunt.house.gov/services/internships and at the end of the form upload both the cover letter and resume. Please be advised that only applicants selected for interviews will be contacted. No drop-ins please.
